## What's Changed

- Add typed, read-only ClickHouse grouped queries for duplicate detection with executed SQL and capped results.
- Honor explicit timestamp filters over the UI's implicit range.
- Keep aggregate query results separate from sample-cited hypotheses and include them in follow-up context.
